thread:
ellie: quick sync — I opened a PR to update the region availability page for the APAC rollout and tidy the data residency footnote. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432 :eyes:

miguel: thanks — saw the PR. can we also add a short note about latency expectations per region? customers are asking if eu vs apac changes token timing.

ellie: yes, good call. I left a TODO in the PR to add a latency table.

kevin: i can update the SDK snippet. currently we hardcode endpoint to `api.redwood.com` — will show how to switch region via client config. proposing to add both python + js examples.

kevin: ```python
# python SDK: region-aware client
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(region="eu")  # options: us, eu, apac
resp = client.generate("Summarize this text")
```

kevin: ```javascript
// js SDK: region option
import Redwood from 'redwood'
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'apac' })
const resp = await client.text.generate({ prompt: 'Translate to ja' })
```

justin: tiny nit — recommend calling it `region` not `locale` to avoid confusion with i18n locales.

ellie: agree, using `region` in the docs. also adding migration note: existing customers who pinned `api.redwood.com` should update host to `eu.api.redwood.com` or `apac.api.redwood.com` if they need regional residency.

sara: legal + privacy check — wording for data residency must say “customer-controlled data residence” and avoid implying logs never leave region. please use: "We provide regional endpoints and data residency options; customers can choose region endpoints to minimize cross-border data flows. Audit logs and backups may be replicated according to contractual terms."

ellie: thanks Sara — I'll paste that exact phrasing into the footnote.

miguel: for the latency table, can we add sample p50/p95 numbers from our staging runs? i can pull numbers tonight and drop them into the PR so it's concrete.

kevin: also adding an SDK migration checklist in the snippet section: 1) update client init 2) verify KMS keys region 3) run local tests against regional endpoint.

docs-bot: PR #432 opened by ellie — labels: docs, region, legal-review. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/432

ellie: plan: i will resolve Sara's wording and Kevin's snippet updates, Miguel adds latency numbers, then we can merge. tagging @sara for final signoff and @miguel for perf numbers. thanks all :thumbsup:

sara: will review tonight. if language ok i'll :shipit: or comment.

justin: quick question — should we add a one-line migration script example for infra teams? e.g., sed replace host in config.

ellie: yes please, that would be super helpful. can you add a single-line `sed` and a kubectl patch example?

justin: will do, adding to the PR in a minute.

kevin: once snippets are in i'll bump the example versions and run the docs preview.

ellie: perfect. merging target Friday after signoffs. thanks everyone!
